t.eng-ummmuhammad: By the fig and the olive

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We have certainly created man in the best of stature
Then We return him to the lowest of the low

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted
So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense
Is not Allah the most just of judges
